headline: Release proof now has a production-observed half: a durable receipt reconciles candidate-green against what the live site actually serves.

items.title: Post-promotion receipt (candidate↔production reconciliation)
items.insight: release-proof was staging-derived only; now api/promotion-receipt.json observes git-ordered prod SHA, live CSP mode, browser console cleanliness, and signal cardinality — honest-dark for anything unobserved.

items.title: CSP production regression guard
items.insight: An accidental enforce→report-only CSP flip at the edge is now a --check failure instead of a silent downgrade.

items.title: Public /status/ reconciliation tile + trust feed
items.insight: Humans see the candidate↔production verdict and streak; agents already have the JSON — and a stale reconciliation now honestly drags the trust score.

items.title: Reconciliation history ledger + streak
items.insight: Every trust signal here earns a history ledger; the receipt now has one too (tail-safe, S282-glue-heal), so recurring stranded-deploy incidents become visible.
